editorial.blurb: Pierogi Kitchen serves authentically made Eastern European comfort food with genuine hospitality and care in a welcoming Chicago neighborhood spot.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the pierogis fresh—they're made daily and incredibly filling, so consider sharing appetizers and mains; arrive hungry and ask your server for extra sour cream on the side.
signatureDishes: pan fried potato pirogies with bacon
sweet cheese pirogies with fruit compote

topDishes.note: crispy, loaded with yummy onions, nostalgic and devoured before photos
